support_story_1_headline: Ni fɛn dilannikɛlaw taara ɲɛ, sigida bɛ sennateliya.
support_story_1_lead: I ka minɛn lakanani ka bɔ fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw jaanw ma minnu tɛ kuma ani seginnkanni tiɲɛnenw.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis bɛ to ka firimiwɛri kura dɔw labɛn tulonkɛlaw ye i n’a fɔ Y1 (a bɛ tali kɛ pankurun dogolenw seginnkanni na i n’a fɔ 6.0, 7.0 ani 8.0) minnu bɛ minɛn kɔrɔw kari u makun na. Min ka jugu ni o bɛɛ ye, u ka siti in bɛ lasɔmini zeru di ani ka se zeru ma ka ɲɛsin baarakɛminɛn kɔrɔw ma minnu tun bɛ baara kɛ walasa ka se ka u yɛrɛ sɔrɔ biriki cogoya la. Updater ani Community Firmware porozɛ bɛ o yɔrɔw ta: an bɛ stock ROM kɔrɔ bɛɛ mara, k’i ka hardware revision sɛgɛsɛgɛ an yɛrɛma, ani k’i ka player to baara la lafiya la.
support_story_1_item_1: Tulonkɛla karilenw kisi: Lakanali sɛgɛsɛgɛliw b’a to fɛn kura kuraw tɛ biriki kɛ abada fɛnɲɛnamafagalan kɔrɔw la.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Inioasis ka izini firimiwɛri fɔlɔw lajɛlen dafalen.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Flashing baarakɛminɛn dafalenw macOS, Linux ani Windows bɛɛ kama.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Board detection automatique walasa i ka pake ɲuman sɔrɔ tuma bɛɛ.
support_story_2_headline: Google Drives tiɲɛnenw tɛ yen. Jateminɛ-baara tɛ. Dɔrɔn ka baara kɛ firimiwɛri.
support_story_2_lead: Teliyaba, sigida ka fɛnsɔrɔsiraw sɛgɛsɛgɛlenw, i bɛ se ka i jigi da minnu kan tiɲɛ na.
support_story_2_body: A ka c’a la, Innioasis porogaramu ofisiyali nɔfɛta kɔrɔ ye ka forobaciyɛn ɲinini kɛ Google Drive jɛgɛnsira waati tɛmɛnenw na, Baidu sankaba tilali salenw, ani gundo zipu filew, minnu tɛ ni baarakɛminɛnw ye minnu bɛ yeelen bɔ. An ye telesarse-rɛzo dɔ jɔ min bɛ se ka da a kan, min yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalen don, ni SHA-256 dafalen sɛgɛsɛgɛlen don, kunnafoni kuraw, ani sigicogo ɲɛminɛlenw senfɛ-senfɛ. Aw ka bolomafaraw bɛ telesarsecogo ni jatigila minnu bɛ o kɛ sanga 24 kɔnɔ, tile 365 kɔnɔ san kɔnɔ, olu mara k’a ɲɛsin u yɛrɛ ma.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Telesarse teliyalen, tilennen, telesarse dan tɛ min na walima ni ladɛrɛsi salen tɛ.
support_story_2_item_2: Ladɔnniyali kura: Aw ye lasɔmini sɔrɔ waati min na sigida ka bɔko kura walima labɛnni kuraw bɛ bɔ.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Ɲɛjirali jɛlenw b’i bila butɔni digilen bɛɛ la.
support_story_2_item_4: Kan caman fɔbagaw ka jɛkulu: A sigilen don kosɛbɛ Angilɛkan, Sinuwakan, Alimankan, Ɛsipaɲɔlikan, Faransikan & Zapɔnkan na.
support_story_3_headline: I ka Innioasis tulonkɛla ka seko bɛɛ dabɔli.
support_story_3_lead: Ka na ni Rockbox ye, ka na ni baarakɛminɛn nɔgɔmanw ye minnu bɛ kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni mɔgɔw sago ye, ani audiophile hɔrɔnya.
support_story_3_body: Stock factory software bɛ i ka Y1 walima Y2 hardware bɛ se ka min kɛ, o ɲɛda dɔrɔn de sɔgɔsɔgɔ. An ka sigida ye Rockbox, baarakɛminɛn nɔgɔmanw, codec audiophile fɔli, ani ladamu barokunw lase ɲɛnamaya ma. An bɛ farikolo-ɲɛnajɛ-minɛnw caman ɲɔgɔnna san ka bɔ an ka bɔrɛ kɔnɔ walasa ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ, ka kɔsegin kɛ, ani k’a sɛgɛsɛgɛ install (dadon) bɛɛ la. Updater dɛmɛni bɛ wari di o sɛgɛsɛgɛli yɔrɔw ma k’a ɲɛsin u yɛrɛ ma ani ka ladamu firimiw dilanni teliya.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox min bɛ digi kelen kan: Audiophile fɔli ani barokunw minnu bɛ kɛ ka kɛɲɛ ni mɔgɔw sago ye, olu bɛ sigi sekɔndi damadɔ kɔnɔ.
support_story_3_item_2: Sigida Firmware: Batiriw ɲɛnabɔli, UI saniyalen, ani bi codec audio audio dɛmɛni.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: An bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ minɛn farikoloma lakikaw kan sani an ka jɔli fɛn o fɛn bɔ.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% fu, porogaramu min bɛ mɔgɔ dogo fɔlɔ, ni piblisite walima tugu-tugu-ɲɔgɔn kɔ tɛ min na.
support_story_4_headline: Innioasis tɛ min kɛ, aw k’an dɛmɛ ka o kɛ.
support_story_4_lead: Sigida ka firimiwɛri lakanani min bɛ i ka minɛnw bali ka bɔ binkɛnɛw kɔnɔ.
support_story_4_body: Ni fɛnɲɛnɛma-tɔn dɔ taara u ka minɛn nata la, fɛn kɔrɔw bɛ bila. Innioasis tɛ Linux dɛmɛni si di, fɛn caman Changements transparents tɛ, ani fɛɛrɛ nɔgɔn tɛ ka segin a kan ni installation dɔ ma ɲɛ. Updater bɛ yen bawo baarakɛlaw minnu ka di kosɛbɛ, olu man kan ka fɔlikɛlan ɲuman dafalen fili. Sigidamɔgɔw ka bolomafara 100% bɛ taa ɲɛsin nin baarakɛminɛn in dabɔli ma bɛɛ ye.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Segin min sɛgɛsɛgɛra, o bɛ woyo hali ni minɛnw banna ka daminɛ.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: MediaTek ka dɛmɛ bɛrɛbɛrɛ bɛ flashing Linux distros kan.
support_story_4_item_3: Yɛlɛmacogo jɛlenw: Bɔli sɛbɛnw ɲɛfɔlenw walasa i k’a dɔn tigitigi fɛn minnu bɛ Changé.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Sigida ka nafolo: Kafe bɛɛ bɛ sɛbɛnmarayɔrɔ da wulilen to, wa bɛɛ tɛ sara.

err_attempt_timeout: Baarakɛminɛn min bɛ yeelen bɔ, o ma ɲɛtaa si jira segin {seconds} kɔnɔ, o de la nin cɛsiri in jɔra.
err_connection_failed_desc: A ma Se ka jɛɲɔgɔnya sabatilen Sìgi ni ntolatanna ye. Aw ye aw jija ka minɛn in faga (aw bɛ baara kɛ ni pinɛ ye walasa ka butɔni reset digi ni aw mago bɛ a la), ka USB bɔ a la, ka segin ka don a la ni a ɲinina aw fɛ.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Flashing tigɛra walima sɛbɛnni baara ma ɲɛ. Aw ye a lajɛ ni USB kabɔri sirilen don kosɛbɛ ani ni batiri chargera ka ɲɛ, o kɔ aw bɛ segin ka a lajɛ.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: A bɛ iko flash (flash) bɛ siri
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Baarakɛminɛn min bɛ yeelen bɔ, o ye layini kelen jira segin {seconds} labanw na, wa a bɛ iko a tɛ taa a fɛ ka firimiw sɛbɛn. A bɛ se ka kɛ ko flash ma ɲɛ. Ni nin tun ye cɛsiri fila laban ye ni fɛɛrɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye sistɛmu dɔ kan min bɛ se ka segin u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, walima ni MTKClient dɔrɔn de bɛ sɔrɔ nin masin in kan, ɔridinatɛri daminɛ kokura ka segin k’a lajɛ.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient dɔrɔn de bɛ sɔrɔ o sigili in kama. A bɛ se ka kɛ ko flash ma ɲɛ. Aw ye ɔridinatɛri daminɛ kokura ani ka segin k’a lajɛ.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Nin ɔridinatɛri in fana bɛ se ka sigi ni SP Flash Tool ye. N’aw bɛ se, aw bɛ wuli ka taa SP Flash Tool la ka segin k’a lajɛ.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: A bɛ se ka kɛ ko flash ma ɲɛ. Aw ye cikan kalan sanfɛ ani ka ɔridinatɛri daminɛ kokura sani aw ka segin k’a lajɛ. N’i ​​ye OK digi, appli bɛna dabila walisa i ka se ka a daminɛ kokura.
err_missing_package_files_title: Firmware Package min tɛ baara kɛ

err_tool_unavailable_desc: Flashing baarakɛminɛn walima sistɛmu drivers wajibiyalenw ma se ka daminɛ. Aw ye sitɛmu ka yamaruyaw lajɛ, ka sofɛrɛ sigicogo lajɛ, walima ka porogaramu in sigi kokura.

err_cache_file_missing_desc: Firmware file min bɛ cache kɔnɔ, o tɛ yen. Porozɛ sugandi walasa ka dosiye bɔlenw jɔ kokura walima ka firimiwɛri archive telesarse kokura. Nin ye sigida dosiye gɛlɛya ye, a tɛ USB jɛgɛnko ye.

themepack_step1_desc:
1. Aw bɛ aw ka fɔlikɛlan daminɛ ni aw ye Power butɔni minɛ.
2. Ni Rockbox daminɛna, i ka USB kabɔri don i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ.
3. Ni ɲininkali kɛra a la fɔlikɛlan ɲɛ kan, i ka USB Storage mode dafa walasa minɛn ka jira i n’a fɔ drive.

themepack_step2_desc: Ikomi baarakɛminɛnw (i n’a fɔ macOS) bɛ dotfiles (i n’a fɔ .rockbox) dogo ka da a kan, i bɛ se ka ANY folder walima drive root sugandi i ka player kan. An bɛna .rockbox ɲɛbilasɛbɛn sɔrɔ an yɛrɛma walima k’a dabɔ i ye.
